reviews.author: Amber Kretzer
reviews.text: Always a pleasant experience here, very friendly staff you can tell they love their jobs and enjoy seeing the kids! Dr.Vora is kind and very informative! Would definitely recommend taking your children here!

reviews.author: Sydney Bowker
reviews.text: The best! Always a great experience.

reviews.author: Audrey Mosel
reviews.text: I’m so grateful for VB Pediatrics & their knowledgeable & kind staff!

reviews.author: Mallory Murray
reviews.text: Love how patient the staff are with my kids. Big shout out to Casey the Office Manager for being so kind and friendly. Debbie at the front desk check out was outstanding. We love Dr Laura Johnson. She has been my kids Pediatrician for 12 years! I would highly recommend Vero Pediatrics to others.

reviews.author: Claire Petrulak
reviews.text: Dr. Stewart is thorough and easy to talk to. So happy with my experience.

reviews.author: Jennifer stover
reviews.text: We love Dr D’Elia! She has been my 17-year-old pediatrician since we moved here in 2013 and my nine-year-old pediatrician since the day he was born. We followed her from Nemours. Vero Beach Pediatrics has a very clean and welcoming office! The team was kind and patient. I would highly recommend Dr D’Elia and Vero Beach Pediatrics!

reviews.author: Lynn Sherman
reviews.text: My son loves going to see his Doctor. Easy parking, very friendly receptionist and staff, clean waiting room (though we hardly ever wait). Each patient room has decals great for ispy and inspiring super hero sound effects :) Thanks to our doctors who give us direct attention and care. As first time parents, it means so much!

reviews.author: Allison “Allensen” Andersen
reviews.text: Dr. Wiji was my son’s first doctor and he was so gentle - his lifetime of experiences shows. Dr. Johnson is a wealth of knowledge and the care my son receives from her and the rest of the office is always the best.

reviews.author: Jessica Summerall
reviews.text: Dr johnson is the absolute best!

reviews.author: T Lopez
reviews.text: Good experience every visit so far. Nice staff all around.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.text: Vero pediatrics has the best doctors. Dr. Johnson is phenomenal. The kids love her so that makes it much easier for them to go. They genuinely care about the children’s well-being. I couldn’t ask for better.
